summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Tuya Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, announcing the poll results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 18, 2026. All proposed resolutions were adopted by shareholders. The report is a routine governance update and does not involve any special-situation corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing merely reflects standard annual meeting procedures with no economic or structural terms disclosed.
